### HB 4168 (2026)

- **Policy ID:** `az-hb-4168-2026`
- **Sponsor / party:** —; —
- **Status:** Enacted as 2026 Session Laws Chapter 140, effective 2026-09-12; section 31 specifies an application and qualification prohibition from 2026-07-01 through 2029-06-30, with retroactive application
- **Provisions:** Section 31 bars the Arizona Commerce Authority from accepting applications for new computer data centers and bars new centers from qualifying for tax relief under A.R.S. 41-1519 from 2026-07-01 through 2029-06-30; it does not pause construction, siting, or local permitting.
- **Mechanism / scope:** incentive_restriction; fiscal
- **Legal effect:** unknown
- **Effective date:** 2026-09-12
- **End condition and limitations:** Section 31 is repealed from and after 2029-06-30.
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.azleg.gov/legtext/57leg/2r/laws/0140.htm>)
